app.title: A real Linux kernel, compiled to WebAssembly
app.description: A minimal Linux kernel compiled to WebAssembly, enabling kernel execution in a Wasm sandbox.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and run the provided build script to generate a .wasm binary.
Execute the binary using a Wasm runtime (e.g., wasmtime) and verify that basic syscalls (read, write) function as expected.
Measure the size of the resulting .wasm file and compare it to a baseline Linux kernel compiled to a native binary.
Run a small user program (e.g., Hello World) compiled to Wasm and execute it inside the kernel, checking output correctness.
